at-0001.title: Round money only with round_money
at-0001.content: Always round monetary Decimal results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0003.title: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes
at-0003.content: Signal domain failures by raising `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly.errors` with the established codes: `invalid_state` for wrong invoice status, `invalid_quantity` for bad quantities, `negative_amount` for negative money.

at-0004.content: When validating integer quantities, exclude `bool` explicitly (`isinstance(quantity, bool)`) before the `isinstance(quantity, int)` check, since `True`/`False` are ints in Python and would otherwise pass.
